title: The Official College of Architects of León (COAL)
description: The Official College of Architects of León (COAL) was established on July 12, 1931, encompassing the regions of León, Asturias, and Galicia. The College of Galicia was legally separated in 1973 and the College of Asturias in 1981.We will upload 77gb of corporate data soon. Detailed personal information (passports), financials, students and clients information and so on.
